name: The Irencrag
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, you may have The Irencrag become a legendary Equipment artifact named Everflame, Heroes' Legacy. If you do, it gains equip {3} and "Equipped creature gets +3/+3" and loses all other abilities.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, you may have The Irencrag become a legendary Equipment artifact named Everflame, Heroes' Legacy. If you do, it gains equip {3} and "Equipped creature gets +3/+3" and loses all other abilities.

needs.what: a way for a resolving effect to change a permanent's NAME for as long as it stays on the battlefield -- cheapest shape: a `name` key on the existing `add_subtype`/`animate` family (or a `becomes` op carrying `name`, `subtypes`, `supertypes`) written onto the object the way `add_subtypes` writes types (src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_characteristics.py:44-49), plus a name layer in `characteristics` so `selector.name` and the legend rule read the new name. It clears the whole "becomes a ... named X" family -- The Irencrag/Everflame, Kenrith's Transformation-style renames, and the Equipment-transforming artifacts printed alongside it.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Nothing in the engine can change a name. `characteristics.py:1319-1321` says so in as many words at the `selector.name` test -- "A name is the most printed characteristic there is and nothing in the pipeline can change one, so it is safe here for the same reason `types` is" -- and the characteristics pipeline has no name layer at all. The two near misses are both wrong shapes: `change_text` is creature-type only and the loader refuses anything else (`change_text only implements 'creature_type'`, src/automtg/cards/loader/effects.py:1958), and `become_copy`'s `except_name` (src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_removal.py:103-128) sets `copying_name` only as a rider on copying some OTHER object -- there is no "Everflame, Heroes' Legacy" card in the pool to copy, and copying one would also replace the type line, cost and abilities that this card is supposed to keep choosing for itself. `add_subtype` can give it Equipment and it is already printed Legendary, so the type half of the sentence is the only half that is expressible.

needs.what: a one-shot, permanent-duration "it loses all other abilities" applied by a resolving effect to a named object (typically `objects: {"self_only": true}`) -- i.e. the `lose_all_abilities` static's effect available as an op, or a `duration: "permanent"` self-applied form, so a trigger can strip the source's printed mana ability and its own trigger at the moment the player says yes.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `lose_all_abilities` exists only as a STATIC effect (src/automtg/cards/loader/vocabulary.py:91; `ABILITY_STATICS = ("lose_all_abilities", "grant_ability")`, src/automtg/engine/characteristics.py:439) and is not in `ops`, so no trigger can apply it. Written as a static on The Irencrag instead it would be unconditional -- it is gathered off the PRINTED face (characteristics.py:430-441), so it would strip "{T}: Add {C}" from the moment the artifact entered, before any legendary creature ever arrived, which is a different and strictly worse card. `static_condition_keys` cannot gate it on the transformation either: it offers `all`, `any`, `cmp`, `counters`, `exists`, `has_city_s_blessing`, `is_attached`, `is_your_turn`, `not`, `top_of_library` and nothing that reads a flag set by a trigger (`has_flag` is in `condition_keys`, not `static_condition_keys`). Gating it on `counters` would work mechanically but this card prints no counter, so that is an invented cost, not this sentence.

needs.what: a one-shot `grant_ability` that can hand over a STATIC from `grantable_abilities` (here the `buff` "Equipped creature gets +3/+3", an `attached` filter) with `duration: "permanent"`, by recording the grant somewhere `_battlefield_statics` walks rather than only where `triggers`/`abilities_of` do.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `grant_ability` op is the closest existing thing and the loader refuses this use outright: `_check_grant_targets` (src/automtg/cards/loader/__init__.py:158-197) raises "the grant_ability *op* hands over a pointer that the characteristics pipeline never reads, so granting the static 'grantable_abilities[n]' with it would do nothing". The `grant_ability` STATIC can grant a static, but a static on this card is always on -- it would give +3/+3 to whatever the artifact is attached to from turn one, with no transformation and no equip, and no `static_condition_keys` clause can switch it on when the trigger resolves (same gap as above). The equip {3} half is fine on its own -- an activated ability with `cost: {"mana": "{3}"}`, an `attach` effect and `sorcery_speed_only`, exactly as data/cards/auto/templates.cards.json:20-46 writes it for +2 Mace -- so only the quoted static is blocked here.
